aboutPage.metaDescription: Menupedia gives restaurants a digital menu guests open with one scan, and that the restaurant keeps up to date itself.

hero.title: Digital menus that restaurants run themselves
hero.intro: Guests scan a QR code at the table and see your menu on their phone, in their language. You change prices, dishes and photos yourself, and it's live in seconds.

story.title: Why Menupedia
story.p1: Printed menus go out of date the moment a price changes or a dish runs out. Many digital menus are just a PDF: hard to read on a phone, the same for every guest, and still a job for someone else to update.
story.p2: Menupedia is built the other way round: a real menu page made for phones, which the restaurant's own team keeps up to date from any device, in as many languages as its guests speak.

s1.title: Get your account
s1.text: We set up your restaurant and send you a link. Invite your staff with their own links: owners manage everything, editors look after the menu.

s2.title: Build your menu
s2.text: Add categories and dishes with prices, photos and dietary labels. A step-by-step checklist and a private preview help you get everything ready before guests see it.

s3.title: Make it yours
s3.text: Choose a design and your colours, add your opening hours, and translate the menu for guests who speak other languages.

s4.title: Put it on the tables
s4.text: Print table cards with your QR code. Guests scan and see an up-to-date menu, and you see how many opened it each day.

audiences.title: Made for both sides of the table

guests.title: For guests
guests.text: A menu that opens instantly on their phone, in their language, with photos, prices in a familiar format, dietary filters and the restaurant's hours and location.

restaurants.title: For restaurants
restaurants.text: No reprinting and no waiting for anyone: change the menu yourself, see what guests do, and look your best on Google and when your menu is shared.

phones.title: Phones first
phones.text: Most guests open a menu on a phone at the table, so every page is designed and tested for small screens first.

everyone.title: Every guest
everyone.text: Five languages, right-to-left included, readable colours and screen-reader support, so no guest is left guessing.

current.title: Always current
current.text: What guests see is what you have today: sold-out dishes are marked, and changes appear straight away.

yours.title: Your restaurant
yours.text: Your name, your design and your colours. The menu should feel like part of your restaurant, not ours.

cta.title: See it for yourself
cta.text: Try our demo restaurant, or browse the menus already on Menupedia.
